phases.title: Test isolation foundation — clear sessionStorage/localStorage between tests
testsFirst: RUN: npm test -- --testPathIgnorePatterns="/node_modules/" features/quran/__tests__/integration/QuranPage.test.tsx features/attendance/__tests__/integration/AttendancePage.test.tsx — confirm sessionStorage-leakage failures (e.g. 'falls back to All Children filter when ?childId is invalid', Edit/Delete session visibility tests) are present before the fix
implementationSteps: Add afterEach(() => { sessionStorage.clear(); localStorage.clear() }) to jest.setup.js so LearnerContext's sessionStorage-persisted selectedChildId (key 'sheath.selectedChildId') does not leak across tests within the same file
doneWhen: RUN: npm test -- --testPathIgnorePatterns="/node_modules/" features/quran/__tests__/integration/QuranPage.test.tsx features/attendance/__tests__/integration/AttendancePage.test.tsx (record pass/fail counts per test in outputs.notes for phase-3)
phases.writeBack: List which QuranPage and AttendancePage integration tests now pass vs still fail after the sessionStorage/localStorage isolation fix — this is phase-3's starting scope. Confirm no other suite regressed.

phases.title: Provider-wrapper fixes (LearnerProvider / HouseholdProvider)
testsFirst: UPDATE Dashboard.test.tsx renderDashboard(): wrap output with <LearnerProvider> alongside existing <HouseholdProvider><DashboardProvider> — 14 tests currently fail with 'useLearner must be used within LearnerProvider' thrown from DashboardProvider
UPDATE LessonsPage.test.tsx render helper: wrap with <LearnerProvider> — 9 tests currently fail with the same error because LessonsPage calls useLearner()

UPDATE LinkedFiltering.test.tsx (5 tests) and DashboardComponents.test.tsx (3 tests in the RecordsProof Component block): wrap each <RecordsProof .../> render with <HouseholdProvider>, adding a small local render helper if none exists — RecordsProof calls useHousehold()
UPDATE QuranPage.test.tsx 'updates child filter when URL childId changes while component stays mounted' test to use the file's existing renderQuranPage() helper instead of bare render(<QuranPage />)
implementationSteps: Dashboard.test.tsx: wrap renderDashboard()'s returned tree with <LearnerProvider> as the outermost provider, keeping <HouseholdProvider> and <DashboardProvider> nested inside it
LessonsPage.test.tsx: wrap its render helper's returned tree with <LearnerProvider>

LinkedFiltering.test.tsx and DashboardComponents.test.tsx: add/use a render helper that wraps <RecordsProof .../> in <HouseholdProvider>; mock @/features/household/front/context's underlying data (householdApi/childrenApi) so studentProfiles match each test's existing expectations, per the testing-patterns skill
QuranPage.test.tsx: replace the bare render(<QuranPage />) call in the 'updates child filter when URL childId changes...' test with the file's renderQuranPage() helper
phases.writeBack: Confirm the 14+5+3+9 provider-related tests now pass. Note any newly-surfaced failures (e.g. a wrapped RecordsProof test now reaching a different assertion) for phase-3, and list the final pass/fail state of QuranPage.test.tsx.

phases.title: Remaining QuranPage/AttendancePage triage
preconditions: phase-1 outputs.notes lists which QuranPage/AttendancePage tests still fail after the isolation fix
phase-2 outputs.notes lists any newly-surfaced QuranPage failures from the provider-wrapper fix
testsFirst: RUN: npm test -- --testPathIgnorePatterns="/node_modules/" features/quran/__tests__/integration/QuranPage.test.tsx features/attendance/__tests__/integration/AttendancePage.test.tsx — using phase-1/phase-2 outputs.notes, identify the exact set of still-failing tests (expected candidates: AttendancePage 'shows summary counts' and 'clicking Present button calls createRecord with status present')
implementationSteps: For each still-failing test: read the current component and the test's expectation. If the test asserts stale copy/behavior, update the test. If the component genuinely regressed relative to the test's reasonable expectation, fix the component. Record which for each in outputs.notes — product-code changes must be flagged for extra review.
phases.writeBack: List every fix made (test-only vs product-code), and confirm both suites are fully green.

phases.title: SubjectsAllTable / SubjectEditDialog naming alignment
testsFirst: UPDATE SubjectsAllTable.test.tsx 'opens edit dialog when Edit is clicked' — change getByRole('dialog', { name: /edit subject/i }) to /edit course/i to match SubjectEditDialog's existing 'Edit course' heading (SubjectsAllTable's own column header reads 'Course / Subject', so 'Edit course' is the established term in this feature)
implementationSteps: Update the test assertion as described. Keep SubjectEditDialog's heading as 'Edit course' unless you find stronger evidence elsewhere in the Subjects feature that it should say 'Edit subject' — if so, change the dialog heading instead and record why in outputs.notes.
phases.writeBack: Confirm SubjectsAllTable.test.tsx passes and state which side (test or dialog heading) was changed and why.

phases.title: Re-enable integration tests in npm test
preconditions: All 7 previously-failing suites pass under npm test -- --testPathIgnorePatterns="/node_modules/"
This flips ~86 files from never-run to must-pass in CI on every future PR — needs a human glance before merging
testsFirst: RUN: npm test (current config, integration tests still excluded) — confirm the existing 127 suites / 935 tests baseline still passes before changing the config
implementationSteps: Remove '/__tests__/integration/' from testPathIgnorePatterns in jest.config.js, leaving only '/node_modules/'
doneWhen: RUN: npm test (full run, no override flags — must show 0 failed across all ~231 suites)
phases.writeBack: Record the final suite/test counts for npm test with integration tests included.
